node: Adult online universities and corporate-partner degree/certificate pathways
summary: Expanded the universe around the underfollowed distribution node where adult learners enter accredited online degrees, stackable certificates, or workforce training through employer partnerships, tuition benefits, and institutional payment/student-success infrastructure. The strongest direct public mappings found in this pass are Strategic Education and Perdoceo; the second-order supplier mapping is Nelnet's education technology and payments segment; Lincoln Educational Services is an adjacent employer-pathway analogue rather than a pure online-degree name. No buy/sell view is implied.
